records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues increased 8.9% for the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Dedicated freight demand in first quarter 2023 was solid and steady.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Expense items that impacted the overall operating ratio are described on the following pages.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: One-Way Truckload and Logistics were challenged by overall market conditions with seasonally less freight available than normal and increased price competition.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Werner Logistics operating income decreased to $4.9 million in first quarter 2023 from $8.7 million in first quarter 2022, due to a seasonally weak freight market in first quarter 2023 compared to a seasonally strong freight market in first quarter 2022.
